scope: equipment-restriction prose consolidation (TODO: Remaining consolidation work). Band rules named *--equipment-restrictions whose whole text is the prohibition the binding encodes (recipient name aside) now reference a shared text. Texts carrying a reason, an equipment list or extra mechanics keep their own prose. No runtime binding, profiles.yaml line or clause identity was changed; the refusal harness (offers plus carried-kit validation, 968 checks over every profile of the 18 affected bands) is identical before and after.

shared-rule.no-missiles-or-armour.name: No Missile Weapons or Armour
shared-rule.no-missiles-or-armour.effect: May not use any missile weapons or armour.

shared-rule.no-equipment-but-bones.name: No Equipment but Bones
shared-rule.no-equipment-but-bones.effect: This warrior never carries any equipment, apart from a few bones used as primitive weapons.

shared-rule.no-equipment-unarmed.name: No Equipment
shared-rule.no-equipment-unarmed.effect: This warrior carries no equipment and suffers no penalty for fighting unarmed.

shared-rule.no-weapons-unarmed.name: No Weapons
shared-rule.no-weapons-unarmed.effect: This warrior may never use weapons and suffers no penalty for fighting unarmed.

equivalence_notes.shared-rule.no-weapons-or-armour: The shared text adds 'or needs', which carnival-of-chaos/plague-cart, forest-goblins-lus/gigantic-spider, night-goblins-mic/troll, skaven-of-clan-skryre-rel/giant-rats and slavers-rel/hounds do not print; it adds no restriction. giant-rats also printed a scraped list header ('None.' / 'Ninguno.') before the prohibition sentence, dropped like the other scraped labels.
equivalence_notes.shared-rule.no-missiles-or-armour: clan-angrund-kep prints 'Slayers may never carry or use missile weapons or any form of armour.'; the shared text is the Karak Azgal wording of the same prohibition. The binding also forbids the constant-save cloak, which no member text names.
equivalence_notes.shared-rule.no-weapons-or-armour-unarmed: Members phrase the exemption as 'fighting unarmed', 'fighting without equipment' or 'without the normal unarmed penalties'; same application.
equivalence_notes.kept_local: Texts with a reason or extra content keep their own prose: mazzalupo-web/black-sheep and dark-elf-corsairs-mou/corsairs (printed list lines), maneaters/sabretusks, norse-explorers-btb/wolves, trollheim-undead/dire-wolves, dark-elves/cold-one-beasthounds, chaos-streets-greenskins cave-squigs and troll, crooked-moon-kep/troll (club clauses), protectorate-of-sigmar-lotd3/hound ('Jaws and Brutality.'), undead/ghouls ('intrinsic attacks'), khemri-cursed-of-karak-zorn/cannibal-dwarfs ('count as Clubs'), underworld-alliance-mim/sewer-squigs (Movement rule), high-elves-lus/sword-wardens ('Honorable warriors'), halflings-mic/piggies, necrarchs-mou/abomination, strigoi-kaz/vampire, survivors-of-strigos-sylv/strigoi-vampire, masters-of-horror-sylv/wolfman, necrarchs-mou/banshee, ogre-hunting-party-web/ogre-hunter, and every rule that names an equipment list or item-specific restriction.
